detail: 2026 second-round pick (38th), acquired by Indiana from Chicago

sources.text: One of the best passers in the draft but undersized. Picked 38th by the Bulls and traded to the Pacers, where he backs up T.J. McConnell.
sources.quote: One of the best passers in this draft. He is undersized, but he is T.J. McConnell's understudy, Braeden Smith.
